name: Symplectic Ghost-Ring
strange: Every non-zero element is simultaneously a zero-divisor and a unit within localized sectors of its own spectrum.
renaming: It preserves a phantom dimension where the product of two non-zero elements can be zero without the elements being nilpotent.
raw:
NAME: Symplectic Ghost-Ring
GENESIS: Quotienting a polynomial ring by the kernel of a non-degenerate, non-associative bilinear form that vanishes on all odd-degree monomials.
FORMAL_SEED: $R[x] / \langle f(x) \cdot g(x) \mid \omega(f,g) = 0 \rangle$
STRANGE_PROPERTY: Every non-zero element is simultaneously a zero-divisor and a unit within localized sectors of its own spectrum.
NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: Exterior Algebra
WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: It preserves a phantom dimension where the product of two non-zero elements can be zero without the elements being nilpotent.
COUNTERFEIT: Grassmann Algebra
BREAK_IT: Assign a metric that forces the symplectic form to become symmetric.
NEXT_MUTATION: Topological (glue a sheaf of non-Hausdorff spaces onto the spectrum)
END
